contentList.content: Allows you to use <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_END_Mindflayer_CrownDomination">Karsus' Compulsion</LSTag> without being a mind flayer.
A mythical ring said to have once belonged to the Netherese archmage Karsus himself. It is said that this ring can be used to command the Crown if the Netherstones aren't enough.
This person has an ironclad will that can challenge even an illithid elder brain.

Refusing to embrace the tadpoles' potential has given you an Unbreakable Will, allowing you to use <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_END_Mindflayer_CrownDomination">Karsus' Compulsion</LSTag> without needing to become a mind flayer.
